title: pavonia cernua
intro: Pavonia cernua, commonly known as Rose Mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family, native to the Americas and used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Rose Mallow include its use in treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infection, and promote wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Rose Mallow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
